watches.name: MONOPUSHER CHRONOGRAPH REVERSE PANDA / BLACK
watches.description: PREORDER - FEBRUARY 2027 DELIVERY The DUMOREAU Monopusher Chronograph is limited to a total of 150 pieces, offered in two dial variations: panda and reverse panda. The price excludes taxes, customs duties, and shipping. As this is a preorder item, cancellations and refunds are not possible. MADE IN SWITZERLAND The design emphasizes legibility through oversized registers and high-contrast colors. It is powered by the manual-wind SW510-M-MPC-B caliber with an élaboré finish. The watch measures 40mm in diameter, 12.5mm thick, with a 46mm lug-to-lug distance and a 20mm strap width. The dial features a two-layer construction with a glossy finish available in both color variations, complemented by polished blue-heated steel hands. The outer chronograph scale is graduated for 15 pulsations. The elapsed minutes register is positioned at 3 o’clock, while the running seconds register is located at 9 o’clock. The watch is water resistant to 100 meters and comes fitted with a black calfskin leather strap featuring the classic racing-hole pattern FUNCTIONS Hours, minutes, running seconds at 9 o'clock Monopusher chronograph: 60 seconds at center, 30 minute counter at 3 o'clock Hacking seconds Manual winding with 63 hours of power reserve CASE 40mm diameter, 12.5mm thickness, 46mm lug-to-lug 316L polished stainless steel Domed sapphire crystals with double-sided antireflective coating 100m water resistance 20mm lug width DIAL & HANDS Two layer construction dial with glossy finish on both colors Blue-heated polished steel hands MOVEMENT Sellita for DUMOREAU SW510-M-MPC-B Manual winding 63 hours power reserve Elaboré finish: Geneva stripes, circular graining, and blue screws 28,800 vibrations per hour (4Hz) STRAP Comes with two straps: black calf leather strap with racing holes pattern and grey epsom leather strap 20mm at the lugs, 18mm at the buckle Dumoreau polished steel buckle

watches.name: DM02 PÉRPETUEL GALLERY
watches.description: PÉRPETUEL GALLERY A bold fusion of West Coast minimalism and Middle Eastern elegance, this limited edition DM02 features a royal blue two-piece dial with Eastern Arabic numerals - a first for the series. Limited to 50 numbered pieces. DIAL REFINEMENT The dial of the DM02 MK2 complements the fluid nature of the watch. It is a two-piece dial construction with guilloche concentric circles at the center and circular brushed finish at the numerals. The large hours and minutes hands are designed for easy readability and are filled with luminous Superluminova. The seconds hand is in military red. The numerals and minute track are printed several times using a traditional pad printer to create a three-dimensional effect. The numerals are also filled with Superluminova. The railroad track features military hours. SWISS MADE The DM02 is designed in California and made in Switzerland by Roventa-Henex. It is powered by a hand-wound SW 210-1 Sellita calibre with a refined finish, which includes bridges with Geneva stripes, main plate with circular graining, rays crown wheel, rays ratchet, and blue screws. It is adjusted to three positions with an accuracy of +/-7 sec/day. It has 18 jewels, a power reserve of 42 hours, and 28,800 vph (4Hz). DIMENSIONS With 39mm in diameter, 9.5mm in height (including sapphire crystal), and a lug to lug distance of 46mm, the DM02 MK2 wears incredibly well on the majority of wrist sizes. It has a strong, yet refined presence on the wrist. The case features a dynamic organic geometry of compound curves that flow from the crystal all the way to the caseback. The twisted lugs blend into the geometry to create one articulated piece. The 6.5mm large knurled crown offers a pleasurable winding experience. The case is made of polished 316L stainless steel. SAPPHIRE CRYSTALS / 100M WR The DM02 MK2 comes equipped with antireflective coated sapphire crystals (front and back) and a pull-out crown engineered for 100 meters (330ft) of water-resistance. SPECIFICATIONS Swiss-made. Polished 316L stainless-steel case. Manual-wound SW 210-1 with a refined finish, which includes bridges with Geneva stripes, main plate with circular graining, rays crown wheel, rays ratchet, and blue screws, 28800 vph, 42 hours power-reserve. 39 mm diameter, 9.5 mm height, 46 mm lug-to-lug. 100 m water-resistant. Sapphire crystal (front and back) with underside AR coating. Two-piece dial construction with guilloche concentric circles at the center (lacquered) and circular brushed finish at numerals. Hours and minutes hands filled with luminous Superluminova. Hours numbers filled with luminous Superluminova. 20 mm strap.

watches.name: DM01 TURQUOISE
watches.description: DIAL REFINEMENT The DM01 features a time-only symmetrical dial with a raised pattern that follows the cushion-shaped geometry of the bezel. The sunburst dial is available in several distinct colors. The applied polished steel hour markers and hands are filled with Superluminova which glows blue in the dark. CASE The case, bezel, and integrated bracelet offer a combination of polished and brushed finishes that reflect light and accentuate the geometry of the watch. The case features a horizontal slit and a polished bevel that continues along the bracelet's edge. The bracelet features a butterfly pry-apart clasp. SPORTS WATCH The DM01 features a screw-down crown and solid case back that offer 100 meters of water resistance. The watch has a flat sapphire crystal. The crown also follows the cushion shape geometry of the bezel and it is embossed with the logo. The 22.7mm wide bracelet (at the lugs connection) tapers down to 16mm at the clasp. SPECIFICATIONS Diameter: 38.60mm. Lug to lug: 46.72mm. Thickness including crystal: 9.75mm. The bracelet tapers from 22.72mm to 16.00mm at the clasp. 316L stainless steel. Sapphire crystal. Screw-down crown. 100m (10 ATM) water-resistant. Miyota 9039 caliber. 42 hours power reserve. 24 jewels. 28,800 VpH. No-date movement. Crown has only two positions.

watches.description: DIAL REFINEMENT The dial of the DM02 complements the fluid nature of the watch case. It is a two-piece dial construction with guilloche concentric circles at the center and circular brushed finish at the numerals. The large hours and minutes hands are designed for easy readability and are filled with luminous Superluminova. The numerals and minute track are printed several times using a traditional pad printer to create a three-dimensional effect. SWISS MADE The DM02 is designed in California and made in Switzerland. It is powered by a hand-wound SW 210-1 Sellita caliber with a refined finish, which includes bridges with Geneva stripes, main plate with circular graining, rays crown wheel, rays ratchet, and blue screws. It is adjusted to three positions with an accuracy of +/-7 sec/day. It has 18 jewels, a power reserve of 42 hours, and 28,800 vph (4Hz). DIMENSIONS With 39mm in diameter, 9.5mm in height including sapphire crystal, and a lug to lug distance of 46mm, the DM02 wears incredibly well on the majority of wrist sizes. It has a strong, yet refined presence on the wrist. The case features a dynamic organic geometry of compound curves that flow from the crystal all the way to the case-back. The twisted lugs blend into the geometry to create one articulated piece. The 6.5mm large knurled crown offers a pleasurable winding experience. The case is made of polished 316L stainless steel.
